aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.heading: About Us
aboutUs.paragraph1: RPEcoJourney is a platform created by Republic Polytechnic students to celebrate and share our commitment to sustainability. Our goal is to showcase innovative projects, creative solutions, and meaningful initiatives that contribute to a greener and more sustainable future.
aboutUs.paragraph2: Through this website, RP students can highlight their environmental efforts, inspire others to take action, and connect with like-minded individuals who care about our planet. RPEcoJourney is not just a collection of projects—it's a growing community of changemakers dedicated to making sustainability a way of life.
aboutUs.visionText: To inspire a community of Republic Polytechnic students who lead the way in building a sustainable and environmentally conscious future.
aboutUs.mission1: To provide a platform for RP students to showcase their sustainability projects and creative green solutions.
aboutUs.mission2: To raise awareness about environmental challenges and promote sustainable practices within the RP community.
aboutUs.mission3: To encourage collaboration and innovation among students passionate about making a positive impact on the planet.
aboutUs.mission4: To celebrate student achievements in sustainability and motivate others to join the journey toward a greener tomorrow.

categories.title: RP Sustainability
categories.introText: At RP, we are committed to embracing sustainability, and our RP Green Plan lays out the roadmap for our sustainability journey. The RP Green Plan is strategically designed to embed sustainability into everything we do whether it's our daily operations, practices, initiatives, or even what we teach in our classes.
